question: 'Rahide' is a long scarf worn by the women of ______ to protect their head from cool breeze as well as to show their traditional social affinity.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Himachal Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rahide**__

 __
 
• **Rahide is a long headscarf worn by the women of Himachal Pradesh to protect their heads from the cool breeze and also to depict their tradition.**
 
• **Rahide** comes in different fabrics and patterns. The most commonly used pattern is the **floral print that denoted the rich flora and fauna of the state and its surroundings.**
 
• These scarves have been made mostly by **local women for centuries.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
